summary: Tested the Training Levels redesign (/explore/levels) and the /api/trainings/catalog API. One CRITICAL blocker came from the SDK 58 upgrade and is now FIXED: the custom /app/frontend/app/+html.tsx did not render headNodes/bodyNodes from useServerDocumentContext(). Because of that, the dev server HTML had no JS bundle <script> and no RNW stylesheet. Every web page was a static SSR snapshot that never hydrated: nothing could be tapped, styles were missing, the bottom nav was stacked vertically and data stayed on a spinner. This was the real cause of the 'perpetual spinner in headless tool' that E1 saw. After the fix every requested flow passes on a 390x844 viewport. The 4 level cards on /explore/training each open /explore/levels?level=N. Level 1 shows the eyebrow 'ΕΠΙΠΕΔΟ 1', the '← Εκπαιδευτικά' control, 4 pills with Level 1 highlighted and ONE content card with only Level 1 content. Tapping the Level 3 pill updates the same page (URL ?level=3, title 'Ομαδικά Sound Baths', Level 1 content gone, document title updated). The scheduled seminar card for Level 1 shows the image, title, '28 & 29 Νοεμβρίου 2026 / Αθήνα / €350' and 'Πληροφορίες & κράτηση →', and tapping it opens /seminar/ekpaideftiko-seminario-ixotherapias-level1-28-29-noemvriou-athina. Levels 2, 3 and 4 show the no-seminar message, and its link opens /explore/training. The carousel shows for all 4 levels; the L3/L4 fallback has 2 photos and the next/prev arrows and dots work. '← Εκπαιδευτικά' goes to /explore/training. An invalid level or no param falls back to Level 1. No page errors. tsc is clean. Backend: catalog shape OK, 1 active Level 1 item, 2 past items with images.

minor.issue: The PAST_CATALOG items (trainings.py, lines ~417-419) have no 'location' or 'price' keys, so the review spec 'each item has slug,title,level,active,date,location,price,image' is not met for past items. The UI does not break because of this.

Two older regression tests are stale because the live site changed: they expect >=3 active items (now 1) and use a hard-coded Level 2 Nov-2026 slug that now returns 404. This is not a code bug; the tests need updating.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by the testing agent. The root HTML did not render headNodes/bodyNodes from useServerDocumentContext(), so no JS bundle or RNW styles were injected and the whole web app was non-interactive.

issues: The 'carousel' for Level 1 and Level 2 has only ONE photo, because only 2 past seminars with images exist (Level 1 Chania and Level 2 Chania). There are no arrows or dots, so it looks like a single static image. Consider adding more past-seminar gallery photos from soundhealing.gr per level.
Touch targets are below 44px: the '← Εκπαιδευτικά' control is 31px tall and the Level pills are 74x32px.
The '← Εκπαιδευτικά' back control sits below the eyebrow and title, not at the top of the page like a usual back affordance. Minor.

Level pills use accessibilityState={{selected}} on role=button; RN-web does not output aria-selected, so screen readers cannot tell which pill is selected. Use accessibilityRole='tab' or add aria-pressed. Minor.

action_items: Keep the +html.tsx fix (useServerDocumentContext with headNodes in <head>, bodyNodes and bodyAttributes in <body>). Re-check the other screens you verified with the headless tool, since every web page was un-hydrated before this fix.
Optional: add more past-seminar photos per level (e.g. gallery images scraped from the past seminar pages) so that Level 1 and Level 2 show a real multi-photo carousel.
Raise the touch targets of the back control and the level pills to at least 44px (e.g. paddingVertical 12 or minHeight 44).
Add location and price to the PAST_CATALOG entries, or relax the spec.
Update the stale tests in /app/backend/tests/test_trainings.py (>=3 active items, hard-coded Level 2 slug).
critical_code_review_comments: TrainingLevels.tsx: switching level with router.setParams keeps the same screen. This is correct and matches the request.
TrainingLevels.tsx: the gallery falls back to all past photos when the level has none. Level 1 and Level 2 each have exactly one same-level photo, so they never fall back to the larger pool.
PhotoCarousel.tsx: the early return `if (!photos.length) return null` comes after the hooks, which is fine. go() uses the measured width; arrows only show on web, and on native the user swipes.
trainings.py: PAST_CATALOG is hard-coded and only shows if the seminar's end_date is in the past. The server date is Nov 2026, so the Aug 2026 Chania seminars count as past.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the new catalog tests except the field-shape test (past items missing location/price); 2 stale older tests in test_trainings.py fail due to changed live data

context_for_next_testing_agent: SDK 58 static web output needs +html.tsx to render useServerDocumentContext().headNodes and bodyNodes; without them the HTML has no entry.bundle script. A quick check: curl localhost:3000/explore/training | grep entry.bundle. Catalog data comes from a live scrape of soundhealing.gr plus PAST_CATALOG; active/past depends on the server date (Nov 2026).
rca_of_issue: Symptom: the web preview showed static, unstyled pages, nothing responded to taps, and useLoad sections stayed on a spinner. Reproduction: curl the page HTML; it has no <script src=...entry.bundle>. Root cause: in Expo Router 58, getStreamingContent passes the JS/CSS asset nodes through ServerDocumentContext (headNodes/bodyNodes), and the custom app/+html.tsx did not render them. Fix: destructure useServerDocumentContext() in Root and render {headNodes} in <head> and {bodyNodes} after {children} in <body>.
